caption: Snow falls under an orange streetlamp, and the snow on the ground beneath the lamp looks orange while the snow farther away looks white.

sa.check: Snow falls under an orange streetlamp.
The snow on the ground beneath the lamp looks orange.
The snow farther away looks white.
The tint fades with distance from the lamp.

pc.expect: The snow looks orange only where the lamp's light reaches and while it is on.
pc.fail: The snow is orange with the lamp off; or stays white under the orange light; or turns a different colour from the light.

pc.expect: The change happens at the same instant as the lamp and is confined to where its light falls.
pc.fail: The snow changes before the lamp; or long after; or surfaces the light cannot reach change too.

pc.expect: The snow falls downward through the light.
pc.fail: It rises; or hangs; or falls sideways in still air.

pc.expect: Nothing moves; only the light changes.
pc.fail: The snow moves; or the lamp moves by itself; or the lit area wanders.
A second lamp appears; or the snow vanishes; or the light becomes solid.

pc.expect: The snow's shape and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The snow changes shape; or the surroundings rearrange; or the lamp changes shape.
